about_the_game:
A mission to complete, a submarine to manage, lives to protect. In Magnavis, your crew’s fate depends on your skills and teamwork. Navigate dangerous depths, repair failing systems, and confront unknown threats lurking underwater. Get ready to dive, stay alert, and fight to survive.

Keep your submarine’s systems online, fix issues, and prevent water from flooding in.

  • Engine Core: Single power source—if depleted, systems shut down and the sub explodes.

  • Machine Maintenance: Inspect machines and repair faults immediately.

  • Oxygen Management: If oxygen runs out, the crew can’t survive—intervene before levels get critical.

  • Hull Integrity: Cracks let water in—patch the hull and stop leaks.

Take missions from stations; each run offers different maps and objectives. Complete main and side missions to keep your crew alive.

Procedural Maps: Maps, objectives, and challenges are randomly generated.

Main & Side Missions: Main missions drive progress; side missions yield extra rewards.

Station Visits: Stop by stations to accept new assignments.

Rewards: Earn a fresh Engine Core and currency for each successful run.

Risk & Reward: Higher difficulty brings bigger payouts—but failure puts everyone at risk.

Caves are generated randomly each mission, making every run unique.

  • Unique Caves: New pathways and exploration areas every time.

  • Narrow & Wide Areas: Adjust your strategy for tight tunnels or open chambers.

  • Changing Hazards: Creature spawns, resources, and obstacles relocate on each dive.

Collaborate with your team to repair broken machines; each puzzle demands a fresh solution.

  • Asymmetric Solution: One player reads instructions, the other executes.

  • Machine Repair: Solve puzzles to restore critical systems.

  • Procedural Puzzles: Encounter new combinations and challenges every mission.

  • 2–4 Player Co-op Mode: Work together with your team to survive.

  • Proximity Chat: Experience intense immersion with voice communication based on distance.

  • Varied Creature Types: Face threats that hunt by sound, react to movement, and respond to light.

  • Player Customization: Place a custom avatar inside your helmet and tweak your skin color for a truly personal look.

  • 3D Sound: Enjoy realistic underwater acoustics with dynamic occlusion and environmental reverb.

content_descriptors.notes: The game plunges you into a gritty, realistic environment where unseen horrors stalk submerged wreckage, and player characters can be brutally slain by creatures lurking in the depths.

name: Magnavis

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3330 3.0 GHz, AMD FX-8300 3.3 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950 or Radeon HD 7970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4690 3.5 GHz, AMD Ryzen 3 1300X 3.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Magnavis is a first-person 3D horror game for 2–4 player co-op. Pilot your submarine through tight caves without crashing, complete assigned missions, repair damaged systems—and whatever you do, don’t die.
supported_languages: English, Turkish, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Bulgarian, Danish, Indonesian, Dutch, Finnish, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Polish, Hungarian, Norwegian, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Thai, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Greek, Czech, Swedish
